reuse.why: Extends the existing per-provider guard (assertBankAccountNotLinked) in one place and extracts the unlink column-clearing from unlinkAccount into clearAccountBankLink, which both paths now share.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset exists once and the six provider link functions only forward the new flag to the single shared guard.

placement.why: All logic stays in accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guards and unlink handler, in the base param type shared by every provider.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and focused tests are changed.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the renamed guard now both checks and mutates (unlinks holders before the link itself runs), which is slightly less obvious than a separate check and release step.
